# Mani House with Sea View

> Holiday rental in Neochori, Stoupa, on the Mani Peninsula (Peloponnese, Greece): a traditional stone house with sea and mountain views, for 4 to 6 guests. Hosted by Maurice Zeegers and Eva Antoniou.

## The house

* Semi-detached stone house on a quiet hillside among olive groves, above Stoupa
* 2 bedrooms with sea views and private balconies (king size bed; queen size bed and bunk bed; sofa beds), baby cot
* 1 bathroom with shower and bath, 1 extra toilet
* Fully equipped kitchen, living area with fireplace, air conditioning in all rooms
* 500 Mbps Starlink internet, washing machine
* 3 balconies and a terrace with sea view, private fenced parking

## Location

* Beaches: Stoupa (6 min by car), Delfinia (7), Kalogria (8), Foneas (8), Kalamitsi (13), Ritsa (18)
* Villages: Stoupa (6 min), Agios Nikolaos (9), Kardamyli (14)
* Nearby: Viros Gorge, Taygetos mountains (west summit 2,407 m), Diros Caves
* Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Mani+House+with+Sea+View/@36.8481106,22.2846082,17z
